description.en: Toggles whether a character's bust-up portrait (see CMND_CREATE_BUSTUP) automatically appears/disappears as they talk.
Character or bust-up handle to configure.
False to stop the bust-up from auto-appearing (e.g. to control its visibility manually).
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Stop these characters' bust-ups from auto-appearing
CMND_SET_AUTO_APPR_BUSTUP(hTenmaL, false);
